blends.notes: Rose and oud with airy amber-saffron sweetness. Elegant and long lasting.
blends.why: Rose and oud are a classic pair; Baccarat Rouge gives lift and sillage.
blends.description: Rose Oud Elegance brings together Oud Isphan, Maryam Rose and Baccarat Rouge 540 in a carefully balanced blend. Rose and oud with airy amber-saffron sweetness. Elegant and long lasting. Expect a warm, sweet, amber, and oud scent with a very strong presence, suited to evening / winter wear.

blends.name: Heavy Rose Oud
blends.notes: Deep red rose on dark oud. Classic Arabic wedding-season scent.
blends.why: Strong rose attar over oud; both are heavy and traditional.
blends.description: Heavy Rose Oud brings together Gule Ahmer, Romantic Oud and Oud Isphan in a carefully balanced blend. Deep red rose on dark oud. Classic Arabic wedding-season scent. Expect a warm, oud and warm scent with a very strong presence, suited to winter / wedding wear.

blends.name: Amber Bomb
blends.notes: Fruity amber with saffron and vanilla. Very loud, sweet and long lasting.
blends.why: Three high-projection sweet-amber scents; loud even in small amounts.
blends.description: Amber Bomb brings together Erba Pura, Baccarat Rouge 540 and Vanilla 28 in a carefully balanced blend. Fruity amber with saffron and vanilla. Very loud, sweet and long lasting. Expect a warm, sweet, amber, and oud scent with a very strong presence, suited to all season / night wear.

blends.name: Sweet Spicy Oud
blends.notes: Dark oud with cinnamon-vanilla sweetness and ginger spice.
blends.why: 9 PM and Wanted add sweet spice on a dark oud base.
blends.description: Sweet Spicy Oud brings together Oud Al Aswad (Black Oud), 9 PM and Azzaro Wanted in a carefully balanced blend. Dark oud with cinnamon-vanilla sweetness and ginger spice. Expect a warm, sweet, spicy, and oud scent with a very strong presence, suited to winter / night wear.

blends.name: Arabian Night
blends.notes: Hot, spicy leather and incense over traditional musk-oud. Heavy and royal.
blends.why: Spicy-leather notes on a traditional attar base give a distinct, strong scent.
blends.description: Arabian Night brings together God of Fire, Tuscan Leather and Ghilaf-e-Kaaba in a carefully balanced blend. Hot, spicy leather and incense over traditional musk-oud. Heavy and royal. Expect a warm, spicy, leather, and oud scent with a very strong presence, suited to winter / night wear.

blends.name: Kaaba Rose Musk
blends.notes: Traditional musk with fresh rose. Strong but smooth and clean.
blends.why: Traditional attar base plus clean musk and rose; strong but not harsh.
blends.description: Kaaba Rose Musk brings together Qiswa Tul Kaaba, White Musk and Rooh e Gulab in a carefully balanced blend. Traditional musk with fresh rose. Strong but smooth and clean. Expect a warm, fresh and warm scent with a strong presence, suited to all season / jummah wear.
